cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Plan Gets Better
cards.instruction: Celebrate every setback as proof that the scheme is becoming more sophisticated, selective, or impossible to detect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The alley's blocked. Excellent: our secret proposal picnic just got harder to discover. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm carrying your table. We have to use the main road.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Better camouflage. Everyone will assume we're moving house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your girlfriend's coming down the road.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Now she can carry the chairs without suspecting romance. The disguise gets more convincing.

mechanism: A directs a secret proposal setup and helps carry furniture while celebrating blocked access and the target arrival as increasingly convincing moving-house camouflage.
confusable: Unlike claiming setbacks were always preplanned, A celebrates each as making the scheme more undetectable now; cooperative authority changes route and work roles.
comparison: A surprise proposal with an approaching target differs from a dwindling supper-club guest list.
seedUse: D140-a alley, table, main road and girlfriend; S02-a changes route and carries a share of the burden.
